## The Consulting Capacity Challenge

Consulting is project-based, but staffing is fixed. You win engagements that require immediate capacity, but permanent hires become bench cost between projects.

Subcontracting to other firms is expensive and risks client relationships. You want to keep work in-house but lack the bodies.

Finding consultants who can adapt to your methodology, client culture, and quality standards quickly is challenging.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Analysts and associates with Big 4 or boutique consulting backgrounds
- Project managers experienced in consulting delivery methodologies
- Subject matter experts across industries and functional areas
- Research and analysis support for proposal development
- White-label capacity that's invisible to your clients
